newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends low on commercial dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends low on commercial dlr demand.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed down on commercial demand for dollars by a big state bank, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 57.65 to the dollar after opening at 57.60 and rising to a high of 57.72, they said.

"The rupee regained some lost ground when sellers came in after the currency fell to 57.72 to the dollar. But import covering by a state bank put too much downward pressure on the rupee," said a Bank of Ceylon Dealer.
Overnight call money rates closed at 10 percent with the market well offered, he said.
